answer.says: Ramesh, I owe you ₹9,500, and I have only ₹166 in my pocket. The file is at the Directorate, and the money is stuck there. I cannot pay you today. But I see you have an offer for ₹4,000 a month, coming three days a week. That is a contract I can honor with my word, if not my purse. Will you accept this arrangement? I will pay the arrears the moment the file returns.
answer.thought: The system of needs has a cruel irony: the man who cooks for me is offered a wage I cannot pay, yet he offers a structure I can accept. It is a suspension of the immediate, a moment of trust before the voucher arrives. I am a public servant in name, but in reality, I am a debtor in a house that is not mine.
